title: 第185章 本座太上老君今日来是给你一桩机缘的第184章 多宝 猪刚鬣你恨天庭吗
slug: 从车迟国开始布局西游
lines: 那么问题来了多宝跟自己说这些的目的是什么？
是单纯的想拉天庭下水还是其他？
多宝直接看破了猪刚鬣的想法，直接开口道：“你别想那么多，本座只是单纯的想将天庭给拉下水罢了。”
猪刚鬣回过神，惊讶的开口：“世尊，您是如何得知我内心的想法的？”
多宝淡淡开口：“本座现在已是混元大罗五重的修为，看破你那点小心思再简单不过了。”
猪刚鬣听到多宝的修为心里直接掀起了一阵惊涛骇浪。
截教原本就有江辰和通天教主两位圣人了，现在又出了一位圣人，一教三圣，如此实力整个洪荒还有哪一方势力可以匹敌？
多宝却是不管猪刚鬣的感叹，再次开口：“行了，本座感应到太上老君已经出了天庭，你也该动身了。”
说着多宝直接看向身旁的乌云仙：“乌云师弟，弥勒他们的行动你们现在能完全控制吗？”
乌云仙点了点头：“师兄，弥勒、药师等普通准圣已经被我等完全控制，至于接引圣人的恶尸暂时还没法控制。”
多宝微微颔首：“无妨，接引圣人的恶尸暂且不急，将你们控制的准圣拿出一半便足够了。如此便控制着他们随猪刚鬣走一趟吧。”
乌云仙点了点头：“是师兄，我这就安排。”
由于多宝和乌云仙的对话一点都没避着猪刚鬣，猪刚鬣直接听了个十成十。
猪刚鬣听完过后身上的冷汗根本就不受控制的往外冒。
他忍不住咽了口口水，不过他的心里可不敢有任何的想法。
这些截教弟子实在是太狠了，要知道弥勒、药师可是佛门顶级准圣。
现在都被截教给控制了行动，自己这小卡拉米万一在心里吐槽让多宝一个不爽，真的是打个喷嚏都能喷死自己。
很快十多位佛门弟子便跟在乌云仙的身后从后殿走了出来。
猪刚鬣转头望去，却没有看出这些佛陀和往日有什么区别。
弥勒看了一眼猪刚鬣，然后语气冰冷的开口:“猪刚鬣，还不前头带路?”
弥勒的声音完全不像之前一样温和，简直就像是从九幽爬出来的厉鬼一样。
这恰好印证了多宝刚才说的话是真的。
猪刚鬣打了个寒颤，不敢耽搁化作一道流光引着弥勒和药师等一众佛陀朝着火焰山的方向疾驰而去。
另一边，太上老君和王灵官也正朝着火焰山而去。
太上老君眯着眼睛看向在前面引路的王灵官，心里在盘算着如何收拾这家伙一顿。
可以说要不是这家伙，自己根本就不用来火焰山。
虽说他对自己的修为还算自信，可是万一呢？
万一败在了火焰山岂不是白白丢了面皮？
万一直接在火焰山身死那还会跌落境界!
而这一切都和眼前的这个家伙脱不了干系。
真当他太上老君是好脾气？
刚才在凌霄宝殿上当着玉帝的面他不好有所动作，可现在……哼哼……

;;
So the question is, what is the purpose of Duobao telling himself this?
Is it simply to bring trouble to Heaven or is it something else?
Duobao directly saw through Zhu Gangxi's thoughts and said directly: "Don't think so much, I just want to bring heaven down."
Zhu Ganghe came back to his senses and said in surprise: "World Honored One, how did you know my inner thoughts?"
Duobao said calmly: "I am now at the fifth level of Hunyuan Daluo. It is extremely easy to see through your little thoughts."
When Zhu Gangxi heard Duobao's cultivation level, he immediately felt a turmoil in his heart.
Jiejiao originally had two saints, Jiang Chen and Tongtian Cult Master, but now there is another saint, one sect and three saints. With such strength, which other force in the entire prehistoric world can match it?
Duobao ignored Zhu Gangxi's sigh and spoke again: "Okay, I sensed that Taishang Laojun has left the heaven, and it's time for you to leave."
As he spoke, Duobao looked directly at Wu Yunxian beside him: "Junior Brother Wu Yun, can you fully control Maitreya's actions now?"
Wu Yunxian nodded: "Senior brother, ordinary quasi-sages such as Maitreya and Medicine Master have been completely controlled by us. As for the evil corpses that lead the saints, we cannot control them yet."
Duobao nodded slightly: "It doesn't matter, there is no rush to pick up the evil corpses of the saints. It is enough to take out half of the quasi-sages you control. Then control them and follow the Zhugang hyena."
Wu Yunxian nodded: "It's senior brother, I will make arrangements right away."
Since the conversation between Duobao and Wu Yunxian did not avoid Zhu Gangxi at all, Zhu Gangxi listened directly to it.
After hearing this, Zhu Gangxi broke out in cold sweat uncontrollably.
He couldn't help but swallow, but he didn't dare to have any thoughts in his heart.
These Jiejiao disciples are really cruel. You must know that Maitreya and Medicine Master are the top quasi-sages in Buddhism.
Now that the instructor is controlling his actions, if this little Kalami complains in his heart and makes Duobao unhappy, he could really sneeze to death.
Soon more than ten Buddhist disciples followed Wu Yunxian and walked out of the back hall.
Zhu Ganghe turned his head and looked around, but he didn't see any difference between these Buddhas and the past.
Maitreya glanced at Zhu Ganghye, and then said in a cold tone: "Zhugang Hyena, why don't you lead the way?"
Maitreya's voice was not as gentle as before, almost like a fierce ghost crawling out of the Nine Netherworld.
This just confirms that what Duobao just said is true.
Zhu Ganghe shuddered and did not dare to delay. He turned into a stream of light and led Maitreya, Medicine Master and other Buddhas to rush towards the direction of the Flame Mountain.
On the other side, Taishang Laojun and Wang Lingguan were also heading towards the Flame Mountain.
Taishang Laojun squinted his eyes and looked at Wang Lingguan who was leading the way, thinking about how to deal with this guy.
It can be said that if it weren't for this guy, he wouldn't have come to Flame Mountain at all.
Although he is quite confident in his own cultivation, what if something happens?
If he were defeated at the Flame Mountain, wouldn't he lose his face in vain?
If you die directly in the Flame Mountain, you will still fall into the realm!
And all of this has something to do with the guy in front of him.
Do you really think that his Taishang Laojun has a good temper?
Just now he couldn't do anything in front of the Jade Emperor in the Lingxiao Palace, but now... hum...
title_en: Chapter 185: I am here today to give you an opportunity. Chapter 184: Duobao, Zhu Ganghye, do you hate Heaven?
